title: New 'Street Fighter' movie has a surprising cast
summary:
A new "Street Fighter" movie came out in theaters this weekend. It is based on a famous fighting video game.

Many people are talking about its cast. Some actors, like Jason Momoa and Noah Centineo, are well known for action movies. But the cast also has WWE wrestlers Roman Reigns and Cody Rhodes, comedians, country singer Orville Peck and rapper 50 Cent, who plays a boxer.

A writer at the entertainment site IndieWire said he did not expect to care about the movie. But each surprising name made him more curious. He called the movie "a mixed bag," but said it is never boring.

The writer asks whether picking a surprising group of famous people could be a new way to get people to see movies.

The movie was expected to earn up to $70 million around the world in its first weekend. It cost about $82 million to make.
why_it_matters: It shows how movie makers try fun, surprising ideas to get kids and families excited to see a film.

keywords.explanation: A cast is the group of people who act in a movie or show.
Wrestlers are athletes who compete by trying to pin or throw each other.
Comedians are performers whose job is to make people laugh.
A mixed bag is something with both good parts and not-so-good parts.
Curious means wanting to know or learn more about something.

background_read: Street Fighter is a famous video game where players pick characters and battle each other.
Movie companies often make films from popular games because many fans already know them.
Choosing which actors play each part is called casting, and surprising picks can get people talking.
